_shape: Edit this file to add shows. `upcoming` and `past` use the same fields; the page sorts each by date and moves nothing between them automatically — a show you played belongs in `past`. Every field except date, venue and city is optional, and the page renders only what is present. NOTHING here is invented: entries are added by hand from real shows.

_fields.title: Optional billing, e.g. 'Morphics live A/V'
_fields.ticket_url: Optional link out to the ticket seller
